scope: one-B70 allocator-pressure isolation; not a full-model or TP4 result

excluded_run.description: A 31.0-GiB allocated arm exited without a new kernel-journal fault, but its final stdout and launcher exit code were not retained after the command session yielded. It is excluded from interpretation.

conclusion: The exact real routed FP8 kernel passes with the live PLE UVA map at both attempt-12 allocated pressure and attempt-12 allocated-plus-reserved pressure. Raw allocated bytes, allocator reservation, and 54-MiB unreserved headroom do not independently reproduce the full-model fault. Extra headroom may remain operationally prudent, but attempt 12 cannot be classified as a simple physical-HBM or PyTorch-reservation OOM. The next full run must either pass with a minimal low-risk placement margin or capture exact per-rank hidden/top-k inputs and pointer/stride metadata for offline replay.
